firm_data.firm_name: Law Offices of Michael E. Pressman
firm_data.firm_description: The Law Offices of Michael E. Pressman is a civil litigation firm concentrating on the defense of personal injury cases and insurance defense matters. The firm represents insurance companies and self-insured corporate clients in all areas of tort litigation.
notable_facts: The Law Offices of Michael E. Pressman has been in existence for over thirty years.
The firm has offices located in New York City, Long Island and New Jersey.

email.subject: AI for Law Offices of Michael E. Pressman, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

With over thirty years defending personal injury and insurance coverage matters, your firm has built something most litigation practices struggle to achieve: deep expertise paired with operational lean-ness.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York market to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on construction and general liability work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
